title: volume probe path guards

summary.behavior: Before any CMake configure/build or engine process launch, both probes fail closed unless the build root, probe executable, and engine executable are real directories/files beneath the repository .local root with no reparse-point target or ancestor. Missing leaves are allowed only where the tool legitimately creates them.
summary.precedent: Issue #500 guard pattern; sibling hardening wave #470/#474/#482/#489/#492

scope: tools-only live probe hardening; no product/API/schema/DSP/driver change; no live volume mutation performed
